name: arkandia
description: Arkandia's toolkit of AI coding-agent skills. `agent-context-dotnet` bootstraps a documentation pack for a .NET repository — AGENTS.md, architecture, ADRs, data model, infrastructure, plus a `docs/dotnet.md` deep-dive covering the solution/project graph, target frameworks and their support status, central package management, Aspire, EF Core, DI, analyzers, packaging and CI — and validates the most important generated claims with you to reduce hallucinations. `plan-and-build` drives a small feature brief from read → explore → plan → adversarial review → your approval → test-first build → gates → commit, one phase at a time, and `plan-and-build-dotnet` adds Azure Boards work items and .NET/Make gates.
